themes.name: Velvet Set
themes.description: A late-evening editorial theme drawn from the intimacy of a jazz club — oxblood warmth, tarnished brass accents, and a paced typographic rhythm between dense heading stacks and airy body prose.

props.text: The room is low-lit. Brass glints off lacquered wood. Type stacks dense and slow, then opens into air — like a phrase held one beat too long, perfectly.
Warmth is a design decision. So is silence between notes.

themes.name: Slab & Canopy
themes.description: A Niemeyer terrace frozen at peak afternoon: brutalist typography casts long shadows over a palette of canopy green, burnt terracotta, and cool turquoise pool water.

props.text: A Niemeyer terrace frozen at peak afternoon. Concrete anchors the type, the canopy breathes above, and the pool waits cold and turquoise at the edge of the frame.
Bitter serif grounds the afternoon heat in deliberate, unhurried rhythm.

themes.name: Pixel Rain
themes.description: Wet-street geometry meets cool technical precision — a morning of sharp edges, triadic snap, and vivid color playing against crisp structure.

props.text: Wet asphalt at dawn. Triadic voltage cutting through cool fog. Every edge is intentional, every color a deliberate strike.

themes.name: Pale Sermon
themes.description: Art Nouveau's organic grammar etched into a structural index — botanical tracery on raw stone, dawn light filtered through stained membrane.

props.text: Botanical tracery pressed into raw stone. Dawn light held in stained membrane. Organic grammar made structural — a sermon in pale ink.
A structural index of living things — traced in wax, pressed in morning.

themes.name: Fired Earth, Still Water
themes.description: A late-night riad courtyard rendered in mineral blue and terracotta — dense ornamental imagery breathing into deep, generous shadow.

props.text: A riad at 2 a.m. — mineral water pooled in tile, embers cooling in terracotta. Ornament so dense it becomes shadow. Shadow so deep it becomes ornament.
Stone remembers heat long after the fire has moved on.

themes.name: Midnight Dispatch
themes.description: A late-night editorial journal rendered in deep navy and acid aqua — the ghost of a glowing CRT distilled into precise print hierarchy.

body.name: IBM Plex Sans
body.stack: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

props.text: The CRT hum, press-checked and cold. Acid aqua bleeds through navy like a wire service alert at 2am — every headline a dispatch from the edge of legibility.
Rendered in IBM Plex Sans — clean columns, measured tension.

themes.name: Lacquer & Rye
themes.description: A Japanese graphic poster sensibility at golden hour — lacquered vermilion meets warm rye field, rendered with the stark precision of a woodblock print.

props.text: Vermilion pressed into warm grain. The woodblock's edge, the harvest's glow — a poster that doesn't ask permission.
Stark. Warm. Precise. The grid holds its line.
